stem: After adding a thick mulch layer, the root zone stays moist much longer than before. What is the strongest irrigation response?
choices: Reassess root-zone moisture and dryback and adjust irrigation rather than keeping the old schedule automatically
Keep the same irrigation schedule because mulch changes only weeds
Increase irrigation to ensure water passes through the mulch
Remove all monitoring because mulch stabilizes moisture completely
rationale: Surface cover changes evaporation and therefore can change irrigation frequency; measured root-zone response should guide adjustment.
